title: 15 October 2015: Paul McCartney live at Bryce Jordan Center, Pennsylvania
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Bryce Jordan Center in State College, Pennsylvania, USA, on 15 October 2015.

View this post on Instagram

It was the 88th show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015. This concert was seen by 12,525 fans.

Paul is getting #OutThere tonight at the @jordancenter in @penn_state. Let us know if you're coming to the show! pic.twitter.com/218k1AMGZ2

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 15, 2015

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).
